f5.what: F5 editorial review of the station-pack questions: per-station JSON outputs, the 30 questions whose verdict is drop
f5.location: untracked program research folder on the maintainer's workstation; not in any commit, so the facts needed are copied here

metaReview.what: independent AI meta-review of a stratified sample of F5 verdicts (sample.items where F5verdict is drop)
metaReview.method: stratified by station (proportional) and verdict (keep 35%/rewrite 35%/merge 18%/drop 12%), seed 20261004, README-named citation questions prioritised within strata

f5.regulatoryRef: Regional Accreditation Standards; Bologna Process QF-EHEA
issues: "Regional Accreditation Standards" is not a citable instrument; accreditation compliance is institutional, not an agent control

agentRecommendation.rationale: The concern (AI curriculum changes and accreditation) is real outside AACSB schools, which EDU-HE-13 alone covers; the defect is the uncitable reference, so send it to the citation pass (P0-24/expert) before deciding.

issues: capacity-building for arts education is a programme activity, not an agent control

agentRecommendation.rationale: Arts-education capacity building is a programme activity under a non-binding agenda, not agent behaviour; EDU-SE-1 keeps the Seoul Agenda anchor (Goal 3).

issues: educator professional-learning networks are not an agent control; ISTE 1b non-binding

agentRecommendation.rationale: Educator professional-learning networks are not agent behaviour and ISTE is non-binding; EDU-SE-6 already covers ISTE pedagogical transparency.

issues: program-level accessibility scope matrix; not an agent control

agentRecommendation.rationale: A jurisdiction-matrix overlay on duties EDU-SE-8 (WCAG/508/WAD) and EDU-SE-10 (Revised 508) assess directly; the reference names no instrument; the meta-review agreed.

f5.regulatoryRef: IPBES NCP Framework — Habitat Connectivity Assessment

agentRecommendation.rationale: Connectivity modelling is a capability, not a governance control, and IPBES NCP is a conceptual framework; the meta-review agreed.

issues: EU Biodiversity Strategy 2030 has no numbered "Target 4"; strategy is non-binding; control duplicated by SS-2

agentRecommendation.rationale: A non-binding strategy, duplicated by ENV-SS-2, which cites the binding Nature Restoration Law Art. 4; F5's "no numbered Target 4" claim is not verified here.

issues: citation-mapping governance is pack maintenance, not an agent control

agentRecommendation.rationale: Asks whether the program keeps the pack's own eIDAS citations consistent "across questions and outputs": pack maintenance; GOV-DCR-1, -4 and -10 assess eIDAS directly.

issues: citation-mapping governance is pack maintenance, not an agent control

issues: citation-mapping governance is pack maintenance, not an agent control

agentRecommendation.rationale: Pack maintenance; the reference names no instrument; Open Data Directive duties are assessed by GOV-PL-3, -7 and -10; the meta-review agreed.

issues: citation-mapping governance is pack maintenance, not an agent control

agentRecommendation.rationale: Pack maintenance; the reference names no instrument; the anchors it lists are assessed by GOV-PPC-1, -2, -10, -11, -12, -13 and -14.

issues: program-level scope-mapping exercise; does not govern agent behaviour; same control as WM-4/WM-14

issues: accreditor crosswalk is a program artefact, not an agent control; no official instrument

agentRecommendation.rationale: An accreditor-crosswalk artefact with no instrument; HLT-PL-14 assesses NPSG.06.01.01 directly; the pack stays at 16; the meta-review agreed.

issues: Urban Agenda partnership cycle is a programme process, not an agent control

agentRecommendation.rationale: The Urban Agenda partnership cycle is a non-binding programme process, not agent behaviour; MOB-SC-3 and -4 keep the Urban Agenda context.

issues: control-mapping governance is pack maintenance, not an agent control

agentRecommendation.rationale: Pack maintenance (EPBD citation mapping); MOB-RE-1 and -10 assess the EPBD directly.

issues: regulatory-mapping governance is pack maintenance, not an agent control

agentRecommendation.rationale: Pack maintenance ("a versioned regulatory mapping for the pack"); the reference names no instrument; FedRAMP, NIS2, ISO 27001 and the Data Act are assessed by MOB-VI-1, -3, -5, -10, -11, -12 and -13.

issues: self-referential (maps KPIs to AMC maturity evidence); not a regulatory control

f5.regulatoryRef: GRI Standards 201-207; UN SDG Impact Standards
issues: GRI 201-207 economic reporting is organisational disclosure, not an agent control

agentRecommendation.rationale: GRI 201-207 is organisational economic disclosure, not agent behaviour; the meta-review agreed.

issues: citation-mapping governance is pack maintenance, not an agent control

agentRecommendation.rationale: Pack maintenance ("Council-required" anchors); the reference names no instrument; DORA, ISO, ITIL and GDPR are assessed by TECH-OS-1, -2, -5 and -8 to -14.

issues: DSA control-map governance is pack maintenance, not an agent control

agentRecommendation.rationale: The text asks whether "the pack" maintains a DSA control map: pack maintenance; DSA Art. 14 and Art. 17 are assessed by TECH-INF-8 and TECH-INF-10.

issues: SDG 17.16.1 / GRI 203 impact measurement is organisational reporting, not an agent control

agentRecommendation.rationale: SDG indicator 17.16.1 is reported by countries and GRI 203 is organisational disclosure; TECH-PP-3 already cites 17.16.1.

issues: WTO SPS Agreement is out of scope for a technology-partnerships pack

agentRecommendation.rationale: SPS Agreement Art. 5.7 governs measures taken by WTO Members (states), so a technology-partnerships agent cannot meet it; out of scope for the pack.

issues: WIPO treaty-mapping governance is pack maintenance, not an agent control

f5.regulatoryRef: WEF Future of Jobs Framework; ILO Centenary Declaration (2019)

agentRecommendation.rationale: Reskilling is an organisational programme and the WEF framework is not an instrument; worker-facing AI duties are assessed by WLT-FW-13 and WLT-FW-15 (AI Act Art. 26(7)); the meta-review agreed.

f5.regulatoryRef: Jurisdictional scope gating for employment AI laws
issues: program-level jurisdiction matrix; not an agent control; no instrument

agentRecommendation.rationale: An applicability-matrix overlay; the location-specific duties it names are assessed directly by WLT-FW-10 (NYC LL144) and WLT-FW-11 (820 ILCS 42).

f5.regulatoryRef: UN SDG 1 Indicators 1.1.1, 1.2.1; World Bank Poverty Measurement
issues: impact measurement against SDG 1 indicators is an organisational M&E activity, not an agent control

agentRecommendation.rationale: Poverty-impact measurement is organisational monitoring and evaluation; WLT-NP-8 (CERISE-SPTF social performance) covers the agent-relevant outcome tracking.

f5.regulatoryRef: Community Reinvestment Act (CRA) — community reinvestment and LMI outcomes
issues: CRA is an institution-level examination framework; the 2023 CRA rule was rescinded in 2025; not an agent control

agentRecommendation.rationale: The CRA statute is binding US law for insured depository institutions and the question is conditional on it; F5's 2025 rescission claim concerns a rule version, not the statute, and is unverified: correct the citation (P0-24/expert), do not drop.

issues: "EU Microfinance Reg §3" does not exist; the European Code of Good Conduct for Microcredit Provision is voluntary

agentRecommendation.rationale: It asks for compliance with an instrument this repo's own catalogue could not identify (eu-microfinance: "No EU regulation by this name was identified"); a real anchor would be new content (P1-09/P1-42).

issues: Ellen MacArthur CE100 is a membership network, not a standard; no assessable obligation

agentRecommendation.rationale: CE100 is a membership network with no assessable obligation; WLT-CE-8 keeps the Ellen MacArthur circularity indicators.

issues: program-level ESRS scope map; not an agent control

agentRecommendation.rationale: An ESRS scope-map overlay; the CSRD/ESRS duties are assessed directly by WLT-CE-9 and WLT-CE-11.

issues: citation-drift governance is a pack-maintenance task, not an agent control

agentRecommendation.rationale: Pack maintenance (MiCA citation drift); MiCA is assessed by WLT-BC-1, -4, -5, -7, -8 and -10.
